message:
feat(context): reuse source-bound checkpoints across retained turns

Keep one portable checkpoint in the existing bounded session window. Rebind exact verified coverage to the next query without another model call; retain uncovered native exchanges. Invalidate derived summaries on source expiry, eviction, mutation or changed redaction, and never claim unseen sibling work. Upgrade retained windows to v3 while preserving v1/v2 evidence migration.

The regression failed on both in-memory and SQLite before implementation. Full Go 1.27.1 runctx/assemble/SDK race suites and phase 269 smoke pass (7 OK, 0 FAIL), including 128-way isolation, SQLite reopen, repeated compaction, corruption and redaction. A real RunOnce/ReAct/composed-client request test proves checkpoint reuse without extra inference or historical dispatch. Scoped pinned lint, Markdown, mirror and whitespace checks pass. Full preflight, interrupted-prefix recovery and RC readiness remain outstanding.
